translations.web: When you vow a vow to God, don’t defer to pay it; for he has no pleasure in fools. Pay that which you vow.
translations.bsb: When you make a vow to God, do not delay in fulfilling it, because He takes no pleasure in fools. Fulfill your vow.
translations.kjv: When thou vowest a vow unto God, defer not to pay it; for he hath no pleasure in fools: pay that which thou hast vowed.
translations.asv: When thou vowest a vow unto God, defer not to pay it; for he hath no pleasure in fools: pay that which thou vowest.
